'''Martijn Peeters Standard Ewok Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Martijn Peeters]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-3696">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3696 Standard Ewok Deck], DeckTech (Martijn "Mare Tino" Peeters, 24 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3696/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3696/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018201143/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3696/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Standard Ewok Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Martijn "Mare Tino" Peeters
* '''Published:''' February 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Someone wanted a standard Ewok Deck. Here one.

=== Strategy ===

Ok startegie is simple. Get Wuta on table quick - Deploy from hand - Get him with Chewie (can get chewie with Madine) - Get him with Madine (can get Madine with Balanced Attack)

The get your locations with Wuta. Deploy ewoks + an Ithorian to each site. You drain a lot and are power a lot.

Don't forget the GT's of the ewoks and ewok weapons.

The powerful furballs strike

This is a basic layout of an Ewok deck. Adapt it or change it. All comments are welcome.
